title: Add support for Forgejo Actions
description: Currently, we show only issues and PRs in the flow. We should be able to CI actions and also allow checking for the logs.
design:
## Implementation Plan

### Architecture
Follow existing patterns from PRTreeProvider and IssueTreeProvider:
- TreeDataProvider with multiple item types (ActionTreeItem, ActionGroupItem, ActionJobItem, ActionMessageItem)
- Group actions by status: Running, Success, Failed, Cancelled
- Expandable items to show jobs within a workflow run

### API Endpoints (Forgejo)
| Operation | Endpoint |
|-----------|----------|
| List runs | GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/tasks |
| Run details | GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id} |
| Jobs | GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/jobs |
| Logs | GET /{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_number}/jobs/{job_index}/logs (web endpoint) |
| Re-run | POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/rerun |

**Note:** Logs use web endpoint, not REST API. Use index_in_repo for URLs, id for API calls.

### Models (src/models/action.ts)
- WorkflowRun - Full run details
- WorkflowRunListItem - Summary for list view
- WorkflowJob - Job details with steps
- WorkflowStep - Step info
- ActionTasksResponse - API response wrapper

### Commands
- forgejo.refreshActions - Refresh the Actions view
- forgejo.openActionInBrowser - Open workflow run in browser
- forgejo.rerunAction - Re-run a failed workflow
- forgejo.viewActionLogs - View logs (TextDocumentContentProvider or OutputChannel)

### File Changes
1. NEW: src/models/action.ts
2. EDIT: src/api/forgejoClient.ts (add methods)
3. NEW: src/providers/actionsTreeProvider.ts
4. EDIT: package.json (view, commands, menus)
5. EDIT: src/extension.ts (registration)
6. NEW: src/__tests__/api/forgejoClient.actions.test.ts
7. NEW: src/__tests__/providers/actionsTreeProvider.test.ts
